_doc: Mutable campaign state. The driver reads it to decide whether to start a cycle; the cycle updates it at the end. A fresh session with no context can resume the campaign from this file alone.
last_cycle_outcome: H56 KILL at the prototype rung, for 2.55 s of GPU. The premise was TRUE and still lost to arithmetic. THE MEASUREMENT, all of it re-analysis of already-logged runs plus one 41-point mouse sweep: best-of-R over randomly RELABELLED copies of the graph needs sigma >= min_promotion_delta_pp / a_R, where a_R = E[max of R standard normals] and R is NOT free - it is floor(guard deadline / per-run wall). At the champion's 1152.0 s/run the 3450 s deadline allows R = 2, so the required sigma is 0.012 / 0.5641896 = 0.021269 pp against a MEASURED 0.019124 pp: a 10% shortfall with no room to buy it back. Exact enumeration over the five measured labellings: plain random best-of-2 is -0.013893 pp, a REGRESSION, because the canonical labelling sits at z = +1.029 (rank 2 of 5) above its own labelling mean; the canonical-anchored design, monotone by construction and the strongest form of the idea, gains +0.000351 pp measured / +0.001507 pp modelled against a 0.012 pp bar. The R that would clear the bar is 13 = 14976 s = 4.16x the 3600 s cap. THE ITEM'S OWN KILL CONDITION, matched compute, is a lookup not a new run: proto_H42.json's 143-cycle connectome curve says doubling REFINEMENT seconds at one labelling buys +0.006275 pp (84.15252755 at 603 s / 71 cycles -> 84.15880258 at 1201 s / 142 cycles), about 18x more than the second labelling buys. microns has room for R = 1 at all (3418 s/run), so the variant is the champion there and a screen requiring a delta on BOTH primaries is not merely wasteful but impossible. mouse has nothing to harvest: the current champion H52 is EXACTLY relabelling-invariant - 41 fresh labellings at an independent permutation base (717000 vs P09's 909000), one distinct value, span 0.0 pp. NOVELTY, recorded as a marginal pass: H56 shares its axis verbatim with killed H01, whose written revival condition is 'std >> 0.02 pp on connectome'; the measured 0.019124 pp does NOT meet it, and the queue item had passed itself through on a paraphrase. It was allowed through on the mechanism difference (full-cost arms vs H01's budget-split arms) and the prototype then vindicated H01's threshold to within 6% of the correct 0.021269 pp. NEW META-RULE M9 generalises this and supersedes M3's existential test. NEW QUEUE: H57 (prefix-shared tail multi-start - share greedy+Rocket+sift once, randomise only the tail, which makes R = 4 affordable and drops the required sigma to 0.011657 pp; its own open question is whether the sigma lives in the prefix or the tail, answerable for ~1.4 h of CPU) and H58 (deliberate labelling at 1x cost, motivated by the z = +1.029 hint, which at n = 5 is explicitly a hint and not a finding). sota.json UNTOUCHED; no score moved. HONEST WEAKNESS, self-reported: sigma is a 5-point estimate whose 95% chi-squared interval is [0.011458, 0.054955] pp, and the effect-size and matched-compute grounds both scale with it - at the upper end the anchored best-of-2 gain would be +0.013473 pp, which clears the bar and beats the control. The RUNTIME ground does not flip and carries the kill alone: microns runs 3418 s against a 3450 s deadline, so R = 1 there and a screen requiring a delta on BOTH primaries cannot be passed. H56's revival condition now names the settling measurement (re-estimate sigma at n >= 11, ~1.9 h, and check its LOWER bound), and M9 carries the same caveat so the next cycle does not read it as tighter than it is.
current_item_note: No job in flight. THE ONE THING THE NEXT CYCLE MUST KNOW is unchanged from cycle 9: P09 is 'awaiting-operator', not done, and cycle 10 did not touch it. Two live items now need it re-measured at n >= 11 for ~1.9 h of GPU - H58 needs it to test whether the canonical labelling is systematically good, and H56's revival condition (c) needs it to confirm this cycle's kill. One study answers both; do them together.

history.note: Port MacBook/MPS -> Windows/RTX 4060 (CUDA). 12 runs, 3 seeds x (H35 connectome, H30 microns, H30 mouse, H35 mouse). All champions re-measured; every seed bit-identical (sigma = 0). Also fixed: CRLF broke the frozen manifest; the guard hook was inert on Windows; audit.py pooled runs across devices and called the frozen scorer with the wrong signature; the driver watchdog could not kill native Windows processes.

Protocol amendment, no algorithm change. Established BOTH legs: (A) a static call-graph classifier (autoresearch/seed_class.py) separates variants that draw from `seed` from those that do not - 0 false-deterministic against a 48-run mouse probe; (B) this device reproduces a repeated seed bit-identically on both primaries (H35 connectome and H30 microns, same seed in a fresh process, 0 positions differing). So the screen now runs 1 seed on the primaries for deterministic variants: 3.17 h -> 1.06 h. Mouse stays at 3 as a falsifying tripwire and confirm_seeds is unchanged, so no promotion-path CI is ever computed on a 1-seed pool. Made operative by seed_plan.py + `sweep.sh --auto-seeds`, pinned by tests/test_seed_plan.py. Corrected the prior analysis's circular claim that protocol_se was unchanged (it is comparator-only by construction; the honest widening at n=1 is +41.4%). Filed P03 after observing an overlapping cycle handoff.

NEW CHAMPION on all three datasets - the first score move of the autonomous campaign. Mechanism: a structural BLOCK move class. Contiguous-block lemma - a node set occupying a contiguous position range is an independent sub-problem, because every edge to a node outside the range keeps its orientation under any internal permutation. So: decompose a block into SCCs, lay them out topologically (all inter-SCC edges become feedforward), keep each SCC's internal order (all intra-SCC edges unchanged), recurse; a block that is a single SCC is halved by position and re-decomposed. Monotone non-decreasing BY CONSTRUCTION, pinned by 31 unit tests. Alternated with the champion's single-node sift, whose move class is disjoint. Confirm (5/5/20 seeds, all bit-identical): connectome 84.097174 (+0.1837 pp vs H35), microns 83.233847 (+0.0276 pp vs H30), mouse 92.917014 (+0.0152 pp). audit exit 0, all 30 runs re-scored exactly. Prior kill H22/M4 revival condition satisfied verbatim (structural neighbourhood, not a rank window); distinct from the one-shot SCC condensation that E2 measured at +0.00013 pp. Critic KEEP; it found five real defects, all addressed: the matched-wall-clock control now covers BOTH primaries (36.0x / 13.0x) and is promoted to experiments/proto_h36_control.py against the production module; two overstated claims in the log were corrected in place (the mouse 'sitting champion' claim was wrong, and the microns stage attribution is neutral not conservative, being MPS-era). Filed H42 (the sizing curve was still rising at 31 cycles when we shipped 12), P04 (the mouse non-inferiority test can only be passed by a large improvement - mis-specified), P05 (stage 4 has no wall-clock guard and microns sits at 3314 s of a 3600 s cap).

RECONSTRUCTED 2026-08-25 to make the history contiguous, NOT a real cycle record. verify_cycle's own diagnostic states driver cycles #1 and #4 (2026-08-09/10) ran and wrote nothing, burning ~33 min of budget invisibly -- a driver-robustness failure that predates the post-cycle diff guard. No item, no gates, no artifact exist for it because none were ever written. This entry documents the gap honestly rather than hiding it; it carries no score and backs no champion.

NEW CHAMPION x3, second score move of the campaign, from two constants. Resumed cycle 4's detached prototype (it survived the session boundary - the post-cycle-#1 detach discipline working as designed). Prototype answered both open questions: (Q2 allocation) at a matched 1200 s connectome budget, sweeps=8/4/2 give 84.1333/84.1353/84.1588, so the cheap inner sift is worth +0.0255 pp on the SAME seconds; (Q1 sizing) the curve saturates at ~143 cycles and past 77 the remaining +0.0047 pp is below the 0.012 pp minimum effect size, which is why 77 ships. Mouse measured over a 9-point grid: every config returns exactly 92.917014, so it is saturated and cannot distinguish allocations. Confirm 5/5/20, all bit-identical; PROTOCOL CI lo +0.0335 (connectome), +0.0063 (microns), -0.1626 (mouse, PASSES non-inferiority). audit exit 0 with 6 explained warnings. THREE THINGS FOR THE NEXT CYCLE. (1) P05 is now BLOCKING (priority 0): microns crosses the 3400 s warn band on every run and has 182 s of margin left, so the next variant that adds stage-4 work on microns overruns the 3600 s cap on a loaded machine - and the guard must degrade DETERMINISTICALLY (a time-sized cycle count would break the bit-reproducibility sota.json and the P02 1-seed screen rest on). (2) P04 is narrower than filed: the mouse gate PASSED here purely because the comparator pool was 20 seeds not 3 (protocol_se ~ sqrt(2/n_c)); re-scope it to 'require a 20-seed mouse comparator' rather than re-specifying the statistic. (3) New item P06: results/*.json discards history.attrs (so per-stage timings are unauditable - H42's runtime attribution is an INFERENCE, not a measurement), and sweep.sh --role confirm ignores campaign.yaml confirm_seeds and silently defaults to 3 seeds. Also: the critic subagent was NOT run this cycle (time), the checklist was self-administered - the one procedural shortfall, recorded in log.md.

The run-level wall-clock guard is built, armed by default and verified on 2 of 3 datasets. No algorithm changed; sota.json untouched. The defect was wider than filed: every stage already honoured a budget and nothing ever passed one, so time_limit=None made every check a dead branch and a run had NO upper bound. eval/runtime_guard.py resolves 3600-150 = 3450 s when the caller gives none; reserve_s measured in proto_P05.json (36.0/20.5/0.1 s of prologue+epilogue outside the deadline) plus abort granularity, both margins pinned by tests/test_runtime_guard.py. ABORT at a stage boundary, never a sizing rule, so the H42 determinism constraint holds. Fires correctly (mouse at --time-limit 3: rocket 2159/5000, sift 2/40, stage4 1/32, degraded=true - and it scored HIGHER than the champion, which is why the flag is structural and not a score comparison). Does not fire: connectome s42 bit-identical to the stored confirm vector (0/136,648 differing, sha b56aa222bedfe958), mouse 3/3 at 92.917014. audit.py gained a runtime_guard check (FAIL truncated / WARN pre-P05) and still exits 0 on the champion evidence. P06(a) closed with it - results/*.json now persist history.attrs as variant_attrs, without which 'did the guard truncate this run?' is unanswerable; per-stage timings are measurements from here (connectome stage 3 = 134.4 s, stage 4 = 697.3 s). UNFINISHED: the microns leg. Launched detached, killed 13 min in by an external actor which appended 'OPERATOR ABORT ... killed by user request' to autoresearch/.sweep/log; no process, no result, running-marker removed without done. Not restarted - relaunching a ~57 min GPU job somebody just killed on a machine they are using is not an unattended cycle's call. NEW FINDING -> P07 (priority 0): the connectome verification was bit-identical in RESULT but took 1483.9 s vs cycle 5's 1226.5-1238.3 s (spread 1.0%), i.e. this machine is ~20% slower under ordinary desktop load; scaled to microns that is ~4100 s against the 3600 s cap, so the CHAMPION's microns configuration does not fit the runtime invariant on a working laptop. consecutive_kills left at 0 deliberately: P05 is not a falsified hypothesis, and the counter exists to detect stalled SCORE hunting.

NEW MOUSE CHAMPION, +0.16588 pp (92.917014 -> 93.082880), n=20 seeds, std 0, from _EPOCHS['mouse'] 5000 -> 0. Cheaper as well as better: 0 gradient steps vs 5000, 0.7 s vs 4.8 s. Primaries bit-identical, championships unchanged, mission target NOT advanced (mouse is a supporting dataset). Conservative PROTOCOL CI lower bound is only +0.0032 pp - persisted as a caveat. Same cycle: H41 killed at the screen on redundancy (91.9% of its credit was reachable by the existing classes) -> new meta-rule M8; S01 closed on both primaries; L01 literature scan finally run, correcting the mission target's attribution and narrowing M4.

New mouse champion 93.082880 -> 93.102826 (+0.01995 pp, 20/20, std 0) from a new move class, sequential exact-gain pair relocation. The connectome gain from the same stage (+0.02093 pp, 5/5, std 0) was REFUSED by the auditor on protocol_ci (needs 0.02343 pp at n=5) and is filed as P09 - a first-ever disagreement between the campaign's two significance criteria. microns bit-identical by design (P07 runtime). Architectural finding: batched-disjoint application discards 99.9% of wide-window moves; sequential application is 11.6x better on the same class.

Half the change shipped, half held for the operator. The relabelling-robustness requirement for degenerate-pool primary promotions is IN FORCE and fails closed; retiring the PROTOCOL CI is HELD. H52 connectome still refused, sota.json untouched. Measured: connectome nuisance sigma 0.019124 pp (5 paired relabellings), paired delta sigma 0.002011 pp, paired one-sided lower bound +0.015626 pp. gates_run omits screen and confirm deliberately: P09 is a protocol item and produced no variant.

Relabelling multi-start, killed at the prototype rung for 2.55 s of GPU. Runtime allows R = 2 on connectome (1152.0 s/run vs a 3450 s deadline) and R = 1 on microns (3418 s/run), so the variant is the champion on a primary by construction. At R = 2 the monotone canonical-anchored design gains +0.000351 pp measured against a 0.012 pp bar; plain random best-of-2 is -0.013893 pp because canonical sits at z = +1.029; the R clearing the bar is 13 = 4.16x the hard cap. Matched compute (the item's own kill condition) is 18x better spent on refinement: +0.006275 pp. mouse champion H52 is exactly relabelling-invariant over 41 fresh labellings. New meta-rule M9 (quantitative form of M3). New queue items H57, H58. gates_run omits screen/confirm/critic deliberately - a prototype-rung kill is terminal, and on this item a screen was impossible, not merely wasteful. Self-reported weakness: at the upper end of sigma's own 95% CI ([0.011458, 0.054955] pp at n = 5) the effect-size and matched-compute grounds flip; the microns runtime ground does not and carries the kill alone.

NEW THIS CYCLE: meta-rule M9 makes the multi-start family decidable on paper - sigma >= min_promotion_delta_pp / a_R at R = floor(deadline / per-run wall) - which is why H56 cost ~4 s of GPU instead of a screen. _escalation_note: cycles_since_score_move is the PRIMARY divergence trigger as of 2026-08-15 (campaign.yaml escalation.divergent_after_k_cycles_without_score_move: 3). Increment it at the end of EVERY cycle regardless of verdict; reset to 0 only on a champion change. It replaces consecutive_kills as the primary trigger because that counter never left 0 in 7 cycles - 4 of them were infrastructure items, which by construction never increment it, and both science items passed. At 3 the campaign is FORCED out of incremental mode and an infrastructure item no longer satisfies the requirement.
